title: Simit (Turkish Sesame Bread Rings)
summary: Twisted yeasted rings dipped in molasses water, rolled thickly in sesame and baked until crisp.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Mix the flours, yeast, sugar and salt, add the water and oil and knead 10 min until smooth and springy.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave in a warm place about 1 h until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide into 6, roll each into a 50 cm rope, fold in half and twist, then join the ends into a ring and pinch well.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Stir the molasses and water in one dish and put the sesame in the other; dip each ring in the molasses mix, let it drip, then press all over in sesame.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Set on the lined trays, stretch each ring to about 15 cm across and rest 15 min. Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 15-18 min until deep brown and crisp; cool on a rack.

tips: Toast the sesame lightly for a nuttier flavour.
Twist the ropes tightly so the rings hold their pattern.
Enjoy with tea, cheese and olives.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
